breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly computes the internal axial force segment by segment (N_AB, N_BC, N_CD) using cut-and-equilibrium at each segment, correctly treating the axial force as piecewise constant with jumps at loading points. It does not treat the internal force as uniform along the full length.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not reduce the problem to a single net-load stress state. Instead, it computes separate stresses (σ_AB, σ_BC, σ_CD) and separate deformations (Δ_AB, Δ_BC, Δ_CD) for each segment, then sums them to get u_D. This is fully consistent with the ground truth's segment-by-segment approach.
